goal_evidence.goal: put the black bowl in the bottom drawer of the cabinet and close it
goal_evidence.interpretation: The bottom drawer is the lowest of the cabinet's three stacked drawers, initially extended with a visible light interior support.
goal_evidence.visible_evidence: The post-release image at step 1637 shows the dark, yellow-rimmed bowl upright within the lowest drawer, resting on its light interior support after the hand lifted away. At step 2759, both actual RGB views show that lowest drawer front retracted into alignment with the cabinet and the upper drawer fronts, without an exposed interior or extended side wall. The latest measured cabinet local point image independently shows the lowest front seated within the cabinet side boundaries. Placement is supported by the earlier direct view, not merely by the bowl becoming occluded after closure.

agent_assessment.summary: The black bowl was placed in the bottom drawer, and the drawer is now closed. The robot has withdrawn clear.
